about: Modwerk source-only silent-pad-trig package for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74, compiled from sdk/analog-rytm-mkii/modules/silent-pad-trig.

mods.title: Silent Pad+Trig Settings
mods.summary: Three checkboxes: pads and TRIG keys select silently outside recording; pads stay silent in LIVE RECORDING; MUTE ALL SOUND keeps a muted track silent from pads, TRIG keys and MIDI, while trigs still record.
